import os,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    print('  shifted-but-absent:',len(disp),disp[:8])
    print('  absent-but-shifted:',len(extra),extra[:8])

# demo4: build exact mapping with backtracking over components, then compute feat->stay pattern.
def assign(gi,go):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    src=[(i,j,gi[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
    outcells={(i,j):go[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if go[i][j]!=bg}
    adj={s:[q for q in [(s[0],s[1]),(s[0],s[1]+1)] if 0<=q[1]<W and outcells.get(q)==s[2]] for s in src}
    n=len(src); used=set(); res={}
    def dfs(k):
        if k==n: return True
        s=src[k]
        for q in sorted(adj[s]):
            if q in used: continue
            used.add(q); res[s]=q
            if dfs(k+1): return True
            del used[q]; del res[s]
        return False

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def assign(gi,go):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]
    src=[(i,j,gi[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
    outcells={(i,j):go[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if go[i][j]!=bg}
    adj={s:[q for q in [(s[0],s[1]),(s[0],s[1]+1)] if 0<=q[1]<W and outcells.get(q)==s[2]] for s in src}
    n=len(src); used=set(); res={}
    def dfs(k):
        if k==n: return True
        s=src[k]
        for q in sorted(adj[s]):
            if q in used: continue
            used.add(q); res[s]=q
            if dfs(k+1): return True
            del used[q]; del res[s]
        return False
    return dfs(0),res

    gi=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]

        cs=set(c)

        for i,j in c:

        pred='MOVE' if out else 'STAY'

        act='STAY' if okst else ('MOVE' if okmv else '?')

    print('demo',k,'mismatches',bad)

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(gi):
    gi=[r[:] for r in gi]; H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    out=[[4 if j+1>=W else gi[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    return out
ok=True
for k in range(1,8):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    p=f(gi)
    n=sum(1 for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if p[i][j]!=go[i][j])

import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
gi=G['Demo pair 1 input']; go=G['Demo pair 1 output']
H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
# Show per-row: columns with nonzero values (color 0 and 6) in input and output
for i in range(H):
    print(i,'in ',[(j,gi[i][j]) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=4])
    print(i,'out',[(j,go[i][j]) for j in range(W) if go[i][j]!=4])

import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
DIRS={'U':(-1,0),'D':(1,0),'L':(0,-1),'R':(0,1),'UL':(-1,-1),'UR':(-1,1),'DL':(1,-1),'DR':(1,1)}
data=[]
for k in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # determine per-input non-bg cell whether it STAYED (same value at same pos in go) - use occupancy multiset match
    incells=[(i,j,gi[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
    ocells=[(i,j,go[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if go[i][j]!=bg]
    inpos=[(i,j) for i,j,_ in incells]
    omult=collections.Counter((i,j) for i,j,_ in ocells)
    for i,j,v in incells:
        stay = omult[(i,j)]==1 and go[i][j]==v
        # ambiguous when counts differ; approximate: assume each input cell maps to exactly one output cell of same color; 
        # if multiple candidates, prefer shift+1? We'll handle ambiguity later.
        feats={
         'stay':stay,'color':v,'incol':i,'inrow':j,
         'U_same':0,'D_same':0,'L_same':0,'R_same':0,'UL_same':0,'UR_same':0,'DL_same':0,'DR_same':0,
         }
        for nm,(di,dj) in DIRS.items():
            q=(i+di,j+dj)
            fv = gi[q[0]][q[1]] if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W else bg
            feats[nm+'_'+('same' if fv==v else ('diff' if fv!=bg else 'bg'))]=fv==v
        data.append((k,i,j,v,stay,feats))
# check consistency: among cells with same feature vector, do stay values agree?
keys=collections.defaultdict(set)
for k,i,j,v,stay,fs in data: keys[(k,tuple(fs.get(nm,n) for nm in sorted(fs)))]|= {stay}
conf=[kk for kk,s in keys.items() if len(s)>1]
print('total',len(data),'feature-vector conflicts:',len(conf))

import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
DIRS={'U':(-1,0),'D':(1,0),'L':(0,-1),'R':(0,1),'UR':(-1,1),'DL':(1,-1)}
# build per-cell features across all demos: which neighbor dirs have SAME color (in input), whether moved/stay
rows_all=[]
for k in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # determine stay/move per cell: match output occupancy multiset of non-bg cells to input cells
    incells=[(i,j,gi[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
    omult=collections.Counter((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if go[i][j]!=bg)
    for i,j,v in incells:
        # candidate destinations: same color cells in output not covered by other input cells
        cand=[(ii,jj) for ii in range(H) for jj in range(W) if go[ii][jj]==v]
        # prefer (i,j) if unique among unused; else try shift+1
        used=set(); st=None; mv=None
        for q in sorted(cand,key=lambda q:(abs(q[0]-i),abs(q[1]-j))):
            if (q[0],q[1]) in used: continue
            if q==(i,j): st=q; break
            if (q[0],q[1])!=(i,j+1): continue
            mv=q; break
        # decide: if st found and unique, stay; if mv found, move
        if st: mv=None
        feat=tuple(sorted(DIRS.keys()))
        fdict={nm:(gi[i+di][j+dj]==v if 0<=i+di<H and 0<=j+dj<W else bg==v) for nm,(di,dj) in DIRS.items()}
        rows_all.append((k,i,j,v,'STAY' if st else 'MOVE',tuple(fdict.values()),fg:=0))
print('SAMPLE:')

conf=[v for v,s in tab.items() if len(s)>1]

steps.input:
for i in [5,6]:
    mi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; mo=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    bg=max(set(v for rr in mi for v in rr), key=lambda v:sum(1 for rr in mi for x in rr if x==v))
    print('pair',i,'bg=',bg)
    for cc in comps_of(mi,bg):
        rs=[r for r,c in cc]; cs=[c for r,c in cc]
        if len(cc)<4: continue
        occ_out={(r,c) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1) for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1) if mo[r][c]!=bg}
        shrunk=[p for p in cc if p not in occ_out]
        grown=[p for p in occ_out if p not in set(cc)]
        print('comp rows',min(rs),max(rs),'cols',min(cs),max(cs),'n',len(cc),'shrunk:',sorted(shrunk),'grown:',sorted(grown)[:20])
